<thought>We need the number of chemically distinct hydrogen environments in the compound, but no SMILES is provided. The only way to obtain that information is to request the 1H NMR spectrum using the proton_nmr_spectra tool, which does not require explicit arguments (it may use a default compound). We'll call the tool and then count the distinct signals reported.</thought>
<action>proton_nmr_spectra</action>
